_comment: Hand-maintained block. gen-manifest.js merges this into docs/p5.gysin.manifest.json. Mechanical fields such as version, commit, shape methods, exports, and examples are derived.

added_apis.name: GysinPlot
added_apis.note: Main class for vector capture, sampling, humanized traces, addressing, and export.

added_apis.name: GysinText.permute
added_apis.note: Dependency-free seeded word permutations; plot.chant() draws them as readable text lines by default.

added_apis.name: bleed
added_apis.note: Seeded additive ink accumulation on contiguous trace fragments, bounded by bleedPasses and coherently offset by bleedSpread.

added_apis.name: tool:pen|blade
added_apis.note: Pen exports preserve all passages; blade exports and statistics keep only the first physical passage.

added_apis.name: angle/pivot
added_apis.note: Per-shape turn in degrees about the shape's own anchor, its sampled bounds, or an explicit point; runs before every disturbance, so breathe, dropout, bleed and hatching live on the turned line. angle 0 stays byte-identical.

added_apis.name: lattice
added_apis.note: Intent verb: writes a phrase in rows that fill a field, turns the sheet once per entry in turns, and writes across again; each row cycles the word order by one and wear scales the disturbance per pass. Returns every row id, pass by pass.

added_apis.name: GysinText.weave / weave
added_apis.note: Seeded text weaving across two through eight sources. The pure helper returns lines with exact source offsets; the plot verb writes those lines, preserves their provenance in JSON, and can shrink the whole group to one shared size within maxWidth.

added_apis.name: GysinPlot.exportPlotterSVG / downloadPlotterSVG
added_apis.note: Intent route for physical SVG output: requires a physical page, clips geometry, optimizes per physical pen group by default, splits mixed-colour layers, emits true top-level Inkscape layers whose visible names start with the physical pen number, preserves pen passes, and writes centre lines while discarding alpha, strokeWeight, and pressure-derived screen styling.

added_apis.name: page: A5|A4|A3|A2
added_apis.note: Built-in physical ISO page presets for SVG, plotter-SVG, HPGL, and statistics: exact millimetre dimensions, 10 mm margins, top-left origin, geometric clipping, and width-fitting scale derived from the canvas.
